name: The Cathedral
subtitle: Sovereign AI research instrument
description: Mac Mini, Hong Kong. 33 PM2 processes. Obsidian vault. Ollama LLMs. Every piece compounds every other piece.

name: The Vault

name: The Meta-Watcher
subtitle: Cross-domain convergence observer
description: Watches all domains simultaneously. Finds where strategies from different fields accidentally agree. Silent from day one.
frontier: Resonance map — do all domains vibrate at the same frequency?

name: Predictive Intelligence
subtitle: 4 layers — graph to predictions
description: Knowledge graph finds structure. Completion engine finds gaps. Visual map makes it visible. Seeds make it autonomous.

name: The Creative Lab
subtitle: Style leaderboard — Paul's taste as data
description: 10 aesthetic strategies compete. Pro Photo vs Manga vs Noir vs Neon. Every /reed generation logged. Paul's selections are ground truth.

name: Reed — Visual Director
subtitle: 10 styles, Daily Lab, shot assignments

name: The Cartographer
subtitle: Operational map + kingdom map
description: Court member 14. Holds two maps: where everything IS (operational) and where the Cathedral HASN'T BEEN (strategic). Never advises. Only maps.

name: Cymatics / Schumann
subtitle: Frequency is structure, resonance is signal
description: Strategy 11. Schumann resonance harmonics (7.83 Hz) mapped to price oscillations and punch rhythms. Standing wave detection. The Cathedral's frequency hypothesis.

name: The Morning Briefing
subtitle: Cathy's voice — daily intelligence
description: 07:30 HKT daily. Chatterbox TTS to Telegram voice note. Session harvests, Muse findings, project status, trading desk update.
frontier: Two-voice podcast format — bull voice reads wins, bear voice reads losses

name: The Muse
subtitle: 3am vault walker — serendipity engine
description: Walks the vault at 3am. Finds cross-domain bridges nobody asked for. Sends one finding to Telegram. The Cathedral's unconscious.
frontier: Muse findings feeding experiment strategies — what if a Muse discovery becomes a trading signal?

name: The Steward
subtitle: Emerges from friction between worldviews
description: Not a strategy — an emergent intelligence. Reads the Roundtable debate and finds what none of them see: accidental agreement, blindspots, the friction signal.
frontier: Steward across all experiment domains, not just trading

name: The Boxing Engine
subtitle: Combination validator + rhythm engine
description: Weight-state relay, defense axis, footwork rhythm. Canonical curriculum. 39 tests. The technical foundation beneath the Boxing Lab.
frontier: Real-time validation during sessions — live coaching overlay

name: Cathedral Slides
subtitle: Visual index of the system — this deck
description: Canonical numbered cards. Each a workspace. Connections visible. The Cathedral made legible to the architect.
frontier: Interactive deck — drag cards, see connections, find blank spaces
